# Legacy observations: run 37014681128

Captured by [legacy-capture](../../../../.github/workflows/legacy-capture.yml) [run 37014681128](https://github.com/altqx/hikari/actions/runs/37014681128) from the legacy wx app at `20d647c4`, under the same conditions as [run 36591631319](../run-36591631319/README.md). `observations.json` is the complete record. The four earlier cases reproduced byte for byte, so only the new case's outputs are kept. Its inputs are in `tools/legacy-capture/inputs`.

| Input | Old app observed | Disposition in the rewrite |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ass-event-edges.ass` | `Dialog:` and a short `Dialogue:` became Lines whose text is the whole line, at zero times in Default; `Commentary:` became a Comment; a `Dialogue:` inside Script Info became the first Line. Actor markers: one kind per load, all of its occurrences; `[hidden][bookmark]Bob` was saved as `[bookmark][hidden]Bob`; `X[hidden]` and `[visible] Cat ` (saved as `[visible]Cat`) behave as the source predicts. | Reproduced (C4-ssa, which also corrects C2). |
| `tlmode-edges.ass` | Pairs read as one Line with the translation line's fields. An original with effect form-feed+D came back **not Unconfirmed**: the trim removes the form feed, so the `\fD` that the legacy save writes is never read back. A blank line between a pair was dropped. A `;` line taken as the translation produced the original's text twice as raw lines, and the `;` line was lost. A last original with no partner got zero times and the Default style. | Reproduced. The Unconfirmed round-trip loss and the `;` partner loss are candidate defects that need named decisions. |
| `ssa-v4.ssa` | Converted to ASS on load: SSA alignment renumbered (6→8, 9→4), Tertiary colour and AlphaLevel dropped, BackColour used for both outline and back, `Marked=1` read as layer 1, margins `0000` read as 0. | Style values decode identically. The rewrite keeps SSA source bytes; conversion to ASS is an explicit operation (document model). |
